page.layout: One column of running text, set in a single block. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot right and centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Ephemerides aliquot habeo, ut alias tibi significavi,
unius tantum anni confici solent, que-
defectu, non facile illis foret: intet[?] has
amicissimo, qui certe, in nostra etiam
Europa, inter hujus artis peritos, pares
haberet admodum paucos, si libris apud
lis factis ad eruditissimis viris, quae omnia
in Perside ignorantur, non esset destitutus. Fatebatur mihi
quidem, Tabulas Astronomicas recentiores, quibus ipsi
Olegh Chan, Samarcand Principe, & magni illius Tei-mur Lenk, hoc est, Teimur Claudi, quem

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "intet" in the line "non facile illis foret: intet has" is hard to read at this scan resolution; the word is uncertain. "Olegh" is printed with a break in the letters ("Oleg h"); read as "Olegh". The page is a scan with show-through and edge marks on the left and right, which are not transcribed.
